how_to_apply: Visit the official website www.cg.nic.in/balodabazar to download the notification and application format.
Print the application format provided from page 4 onwards of the PDF notification.
Fill in all required details clearly in Hindi or English, including personal data, qualification, and employment details.
Affix a self-attested passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Attach self-attested copies of all mark sheets, degrees, caste certificates, domicile certificates, employment registration cards, experience certificates, and other required documents.
Enclose 02 self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 5 postage stamps affixed.
Write the name of the applied post and category clearly on top of the main envelope.

Send the completed application form through Registered Post or Speed Post to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Balodabazar-Bhatapara, District Balodabazar-Bhatapara (Chhattisgarh) Pin 493332 on or before 30 October 2026 by 05:30 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date and time (30 October 2026, 05:30 PM) or through unauthorized modes will be summarily rejected. Separate applications must be submitted if applying for more than one post. Incomplete, unclear, or defective applications will be cancelled without any notice. The candidate must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh. Contract appointment will remain valid up to 28 February 2027, subject to extension based on performance, capacity, behavior, and mutual agreement. Applicants working in government or semi-government institutions must submit their application through the proper channel along with an NOC. The decision of the District Programme Coordinator / Collector regarding appointment and recruitment will be final and binding. The number of vacancies is subject to change.

content_sections.text: Applicants must be native residents of Chhattisgarh.

rows.qualification_required: Any recognized University MCA (Computer Science / IT) / M.Sc. (Computer Science / IT) / M.Sc. or equivalent degree; OR recognized University B.Sc. (Computer Science / IT) / B.E. / B.Tech. or equivalent degree.
First Class M.A. / B.E. / MRTM (Master of Rural Technology and Management) / Post Graduate in Mathematics / Physics.
First Class B.E. Computer Science / MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science / B.E. (IT)) with priority given to knowledge of .NET Technology / Java / MS.SQL / Oracle.

Higher Secondary with percentage weighted out of 100 marks; Minimum educational qualification of B.Com. with weightage out of 100 marks (55% marks in B.Com. for SC and ST categories, and 50% marks in B.Com. for Baster and Surguja divisions for second-class B.Com. pass).

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Balodabazar Bhatapara Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on merit list preparation from academic qualifications and experience, followed by a skill test or practical exam. Assistant Programmer: Weightage given to minimum educational qualification percentage out of 100 marks (45%), Computer practical test merit marks out of 100 (40% with minimum 60% required), and work experience in government rural development schemes (1 to 2 years: 5 marks, up to 5 years: 10 marks, above 5 years: 15 marks). Programme Officer: Weightage given to minimum educational qualification out of 100 marks (70%), Computer practical test merit out of 100 marks (15%), and work experience in government rural development schemes (1 to 2 years: 5 marks, up to 5 years: 10 marks, above 5 years: 15 marks). Computer Programmer: Weightage given to minimum educational qualification out of 100 marks (70%), Computer practical test marks (15%), .NET Technology/Java/MS.SQL/Oracle knowledge (5%), and work experience up to 2 years (5 marks) or above 2 years (10 marks). Accountant: Higher secondary marks weightage (20%), B.Com. qualification marks weightage out of 100 marks (50%), computer practical test marks (15%), and work experience in government rural development schemes (1 to 2 years: 5 marks, up to 5 years: 10 marks, above 5 years: 15 marks).

faq.question: Q1. What is Zila Panchayat Balodabazar Bhatapara Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification for filling 7 contract-based vacancies for Assistant Programmer, Programme Officer, Computer Programmer, and Accountant posts under Vikshit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar & Aajeevika Mission (Gramin) in Balodabazar-Bhatapara district.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies are advertised across Assistant Programmer (1), Programme Officer (3), Computer Programmer (1), and Accountant (2) posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications by Registered or Speed Post is 30 October 2026 up to 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Accountant post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Accountant post require Higher Secondary education and a B.Com. degree with prescribed percentage criteria (55% for SC/ST and 50% for Baster and Surguja divisions for second-class B.Com. pass).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years as of 01 January 2026, with relaxations applicable for local residents of Chhattisgarh and eligible government/contract employees as per GAD norms.
